mapper.sql: I.ID AS "id" ,I.SELLER_ID AS "sellerId" ,U.NICKNAME AS "sellerName" ,I.CATEGORY AS "category" ,I.TITLE AS "title" ,I.PRICE AS "price" ,I.ITEM_COND AS "cond" ,I.TRADE_TYPE AS "tradeType" ,I.REGION AS "region" ,I.STATUS AS "status" ,I.VIEW_CNT AS "views" ,I.LIKE_CNT AS "likes" ,I.CHAT_CNT AS "chats" ,(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM I.BUMP_DAY) * 1000)::BIGINT AS "bumpAt" ,(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM I.INS_DAY) * 1000)::BIGINT AS "insAt" ,(SELECT P.ID FROM T_MARKET_PHOTO P WHERE P.ITEM_ID = I.ID ORDER BY P.ORD, P.ID LIMIT 1) AS "photoId"
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_MARKET_ITEM (SELLER_ID, CATEGORY, TITLE, PRICE, DESCRIPTION, ITEM_COND, TRADE_TYPE, REGION) VALUES (#{sellerId}, #{category}, #{title}, #{price}, #{description}, #{cond}, #{tradeType}, #{region})
mapper.select:
SELECT
,I.DESCRIPTION AS "description" ,I.REPORT_CNT AS "reports"
,EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_MARKET_LIKE L WHERE L.ITEM_ID = I.ID AND L.USER_ID = #{me}) AS "liked"
,FALSE AS "liked"
FROM T_MARKET_ITEM I JOIN T_USER U ON U.ID = I.SELLER_ID WHERE 1=1 AND I.ID = #{id} AND I.DEL_DAY IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE T_MARKET_ITEM SET VIEW_CNT = VIEW_CNT + 1 WHERE ID = #{id}
UPDATE T_MARKET_ITEM SET BUMP_DAY = NOW() WHERE 1=1 AND ID = #{id} AND SELLER_ID = #{sellerId} AND DEL_DAY IS NULL AND STATUS = 'SALE' AND BUMP_DAY < NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_MARKET_ITEM WHERE 1=1 AND SELLER_ID = #{sellerId} AND INS_DAY >= (DATE_TRUNC('day', NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_MARKET_ITEM WHERE 1=1 AND SELLER_ID = #{sellerId} AND DEL_DAY IS NULL AND STATUS IN ('SALE', 'RESERVED')

SELECT U.NICKNAME AS "nickname" ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_MARKET_ITEM I WHERE I.SELLER_ID = U.ID AND I.DEL_DAY IS NULL AND I.STATUS IN ('SALE', 'RESERVED'))::INT AS "itemCount" ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_MARKET_ITEM I WHERE I.SELLER_ID = U.ID AND I.DEL_DAY IS NULL AND I.STATUS = 'SOLD')::INT AS "soldCount" ,(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM U.INS_DAY) * 1000)::BIGINT AS "joinedAt" FROM T_USER U WHERE U.ID = #{sellerId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_MARKET_PHOTO (ITEM_ID, ORD, CONTENT_TYPE, BYTES, DATA, THUMB) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{ord}, #{contentType}, #{bytes}, #{data}, #{thumb,jdbcType=BINARY})
mapper.select: SELECT ID FROM T_MARKET_PHOTO WHERE ITEM_ID = #{itemId} ORDER BY ORD, ID
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM T_MARKET_PHOTO WHERE ITEM_ID = #{itemId} AND ID = #{photoId}
mapper.update: UPDATE T_MARKET_PHOTO SET ORD = #{ord} WHERE ITEM_ID = #{itemId} AND ID = #{photoId}
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN #{thumb} AND P.THUMB IS NOT NULL THEN 'image/jpeg' ELSE P.CONTENT_TYPE END AS "contentType" ,CASE WHEN #{thumb} AND P.THUMB IS NOT NULL THEN P.THUMB ELSE P.DATA END AS "data" FROM T_MARKET_PHOTO P JOIN T_MARKET_ITEM I ON I.ID = P.ITEM_ID WHERE 1=1 AND P.ID = #{id} AND I.DEL_DAY IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_MARKET_LIKE (USER_ID, ITEM_ID) VALUES (#{userId}, #{itemId}) ON CONFLICT (USER_ID, ITEM_ID) DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM T_MARKET_LIKE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND ITEM_ID = #{itemId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_MARKET_CHAT (ITEM_ID, BUYER_ID, ROOM_ID) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{buyerId}, #{roomId}) ON CONFLICT (ITEM_ID, BUYER_ID) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE T_MARKET_ITEM SET CHAT_CNT = CHAT_CNT + 1 WHERE ID = #{itemId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_MARKET_REPORT (ITEM_ID, USER_ID, REASON) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{userId}, #{reason}) ON CONFLICT (ITEM_ID, USER_ID) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: UPDATE T_MARKET_ITEM SET REPORT_CNT = REPORT_CNT + 1 ,STATUS = CASE WHEN REPORT_CNT + 1 >= #{limit} THEN 'HIDDEN' ELSE STATUS END WHERE ID = #{itemId} RETURNING REPORT_CNT
